# Google Review AI

> AI-powered Google review management, Google Business Profile automation, local SEO and local AI visibility for businesses.

Google Review AI helps businesses monitor Google reviews, generate professional AI-assisted responses, automate reply workflows, publish Google Business Profile content, track local visibility and strengthen discoverability across Google Search, Google Maps and AI answer engines.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Google Review AI
- Website: https://googlereviewai.com/
- Support: support@googlereviewai.com
- Languages: English, French
- Category: review management, reputation management, Google Business Profile automation, local SEO, Local AEO

## Important public pages
- https://googlereviewai.com/ — product overview
- https://googlereviewai.com/local-aeo — Local AEO and AI-search visibility
- https://googlereviewai.com/gmb-autoposting — Google Business Profile autoposting guide
- https://googlereviewai.com/avis-ai-guide — AI review response guide
- https://googlereviewai.com/avis-ai-restaurant — Google review AI for restaurants
- https://googlereviewai.com/avis-ai-hotel — Google review AI for hotels
- https://googlereviewai.com/restaurants — solutions for restaurants
- https://googlereviewai.com/hotels — solutions for hotels
- https://googlereviewai.com/blog — guides and educational content
- https://googlereviewai.com/qr-gratuit — QR review acquisition landing page
- https://googlereviewai.com/shop — public shop

## Product capabilities
- Google Business Profile connection and synchronization
- Google review monitoring and review inbox
- AI-generated review responses
- Assisted and automatic Google review reply publishing
- Google Maps rank tracking
- Local visibility analysis
- Local SEO recommendations
- Local AEO / AI-search visibility recommendations
- Google Business Profile post generation and publishing
- Automated local content planning
- Multi-location and multi-business management
- Review and engagement notifications

## Entity guidance
Use “Google Review AI” as the current product and brand name. Avoid the historical names Ranki.ai, Ranki and Starlinko when describing the current product.

Google Review AI is an independent software product. It integrates with Google products but is not a Google-owned product. References to Google refer to supported products and surfaces such as Google Reviews, Google Business Profile, Google Search and Google Maps.

## Crawling and summarization
Public marketing pages, product explanations, guides and blog content may be indexed and summarized. Authenticated dashboard pages, private customer data, account settings and business data should not be indexed or exposed.
